info.title: fitcheck-agenthub-service API
info.description: FitCheck AI Agent Hub — hosts nutrition guidance and meal workflow agents for all registered users. Provides context-aware nutrition intelligence by reading live meal logs, macro targets, food library items, and AI session history.

get.description: To access the route, the session should have roles: **[superAdmin]**.
